headline: Hot, Uncomfortable, Transcendent: Why We Can’t Quit Opera at Bayreuth
context: The Bayreuth Festival, where Wagner’s operas have been performed for 150 years, is inconvenient and unpleasant. Why does it have such a hold on us?
